Slam City with Scottie Pippen.name: Slam City with Scottie Pippen
Slam City with Scottie Pippen.summary: Scottie Pippen is here in person to school you in this sports FMV game. Played in first-person mode, you'll go one-on-one in this single-player basketball game as you work the court to earn Respect points for defensive moves such as steals and blocks, then drive the lane and toss up your shots.
